_README.purpose: Hand-curated per-building overrides, keyed by OSM id ('way/<id>' or 'relation/<id>') or by street address.

shape.name: display name override, optional
shape.hide: boolean, optional — skip the building entirely
shape.floorH: number, optional — storey height for the facade engine

_README.twoLayers: This file is read TWICE, by two different consumers, with two different precedences. Both are intended.

buildTimeDefault.why: gis.json is a record of the survey: real OSM tags win, and the override only fills gaps so the baked data stays honest about what came from OSM (see each building's heightSource).

runtimeOverride.who: src/world/Buildings.ts — the height actually extruded in the world
runtimeOverride.why: the override is curated by hand, so at render time it wins over the OSM tag it was written to correct.

_README.note: style / floorH / bayW / hide / name always apply at runtime. When OSM already carries a correct height, an override.heightM changes what is rendered but not what gis.json records.
